entry.title: perf(dictionaries): phrase and pitch index CDN rkyv blobs with zero-c…
entry.content:
perf(dictionaries): phrase and pitch index CDN rkyv blobs with zero-copy access

Slice 2b/2c of the startup CPU elimination:

- phrase module split into {mod, index, detail}; the phrase index is
  now available as a deterministic CDN blob (phrases/phrase_index.rkyv,
  u128-keyed BTree forms) consumed via rkyv::access — no 48 MB JSON
  scan and no inverted-index rebuild on every start. Free-function API
  unchanged in shape; borrowing signatures switched to owned entries
  (lesson_builder, seed_ready_phrases, phrase_checker adapted).
- pitch module split into {mod, index}; pitch/index.rkyv blob with the
  same pattern; get_audio_for_* return owned entries.
- loaders fetch blobs first (manifest-guard verified) with JSON/text
  fallback chains mirroring furigana/vocabulary.
- utils build-cdn-rkyv builds both new blobs with freshness checks;
  measured locally: phrase 60.4 MB (1.25x the JSON), pitch 12.5 MB
  (1.06x).
- deploy registries: VERSIONED_FILES + RKYV_BLOB_SOURCES +
  explicit release-updated cache rule for the phrase blob.
- e2e: cdn-manifest.txt gains the two blobs; loading_rkyv fast-path
  assert now requires all four .rkyv fetches and no index JSON fetches.
- dropped dead furigana_dict_from_rkyv (superseded by access path).

Measured on real CDN data (native): phrase JSON parse 263ms and pitch
74ms collapse into ~tens of ms of access validation.

entry.title: perf(loaders): honest per-resource readiness flags + zero-copy rkyv a…
entry.content:
perf(loaders): honest per-resource readiness flags + zero-copy rkyv access for vocabulary/furigana

Slice 1 (observability):
- routes.rs: each stage-2/3 readiness flag now flips when ITS loader
  finishes (tracked wrapper) instead of after the stage-wide join!
  barrier — the loading overlay counter no longer stalls on '1 of 9'
  for the whole stage-2 wall time. Stage barriers, the solo stage-1
  dictionary load and the terminal is_jlpt_content_loaded signal (set
  after seeding/precache phases) are preserved unchanged.
- Loaders log fetch/cache-read/parse split timings.

Slice 2a (zero-copy access):
- vocabulary module split into {mod, info, chunks, blob}; CDN rkyv blob
  and the local rkyv cache are now consumed via rkyv::access over an
  immortal AlignedVec copy (no owned-structure build, no alloc storm);
  JSON-chunk fallback keeps the owned path behind the same free-function
  lookup API.
- furigana module split into {mod, parse}; FuriganaStore dispatches
  lookups over the owned dictionary (text fallback) and the archived
  view (CDN blob); annotator boundary works on owned entry clones.
- kanji.rs popular_words uses the free lookup function.
- now_ms() is platform-safe on non-wasm targets (tests).

Measured on real CDN data (native): vocab from_bytes 147ms -> access
74ms; furigana 97ms -> 23ms; parity covered by rstest suites.

entry.title: fix(lesson): AudioRecall follows the reveal pattern — self-assessment…
entry.content:
fix(lesson): AudioRecall follows the reveal pattern — self-assessment on the answer side

Owner report: the audio-recall card offered «Знаю/Не знаю» directly on
the question side (quiz pattern). The correct canon mirrors every other
lesson card: the question side holds the audio plus a «Показать» button
(Space = replay, Enter = reveal); the word + reading + translation are
revealed first, and only then the learner self-assesses with
«Не знаю [1]» / «Знаю [2]», which arm the manual advance (ADR-033).

Keyboard matrix (documented + unit-tested): before the reveal only
replay/reveal work; on the revealed-not-yet-rated card 1/2 dispatch
through on_audio_answer (pending_rating + waiting_for_next) — the
audio-rate branch is pinned above the generic rating branch so digits
never bypass the ADR-033 contract; after the answer the universal
dismiss path advances.

entry.title: feat(lesson): strict-recall for late-stage words + AudioRecall mode +…
entry.content:
feat(lesson): strict-recall for late-stage words + AudioRecall mode + acquaintance audio front

Close two learning gaps for vocabulary:

1. Recognition formats (Quiz, YesNo) hinted answers on late-stage words,
   letting barely-known cards coast into `is_known_card` (stability > 21)
   on guessed recognition. Late stage (in_progress | known) now allows
   strict-recall formats only: Normal 20% / AudioRecall 30% / Reversed
   30% / GrammarMutated 20%. High-difficulty words keep all five formats
   at an even 20% each (the YesNo exclusion gate is lifted for them).

2. Visual fixation without audio fixation: new `LessonCardView::AudioRecall`
   plays the word (CDN pitch audio / TTS) with no text on the question
   side; the learner self-assesses with know/don't know (1/2), Space
   replays the audio, and the answer side is the classic word + reading +
   translation. Audio availability is a single reactive signal sampled
   once per showing (mute/pitch-loader flips apply to the NEXT card);
   when unavailable the card renders and behaves as Normal everywhere
   (renderer mapping, container branch, keyboard gate) — no split-brain.

Acquaintance: the reverse subphase (ru->jp) front is now a 50/50 mix of
the text translation and an audio front (autoplay + replay, Space =
replay / Enter = reveal); the coin is flipped once per card per subphase
and frozen for both outcomes. Audio fronts require real audio
availability (mute included), manual replay is never muted.

Dead code removed: new-card view branches of the lesson generator
(new words reach lessons only through the acquaintance hand,
NewCardPolicy::Exclude in production) with defensive Normal fallbacks.

Tests: seeded distribution suites (late stage never gets Quiz/YesNo over
500 seeds; all strict forms reachable), repeat-pool contracts, serde
roundtrip, handler unit tests, wasm tests for the card front (word
absent from DOM), both container routing branches, and the freeze/resample
semantics of the audio mode.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.content:
fix(landing): drop stale KO/VI 'in development' labels, surface JLPT N5-N1 coverage

Korean and Vietnamese shipped with the 2026-09-08 KO/VI content release,
but several surfaces still claimed they were planned. This removes the
remaining stale labels and states the full JLPT grammar & kanji coverage
(N5-N1, verified: grammar_v2.json 720 rules incl. 205 N1; kanji
animations for all 5 levels) where it was missing.

Slice 1 - stale 'in development' labels:
- Remove the site-level WIP banner: Locale::is_development(),
  Content::banner_wip, the banner render + is_blog_article_route in
  Layout, and the .landing-wip-banner CSS (processed.css regenerated).
- llms.txt: interface languages now 'English, Russian, Korean and
  Vietnamese' (was: EN/RU with KO/VI planned).
- README.md / README.ru.md: principles, roadmap and the RU language
  table now list four shipped languages (Indonesian/Spanish stay
  planned).
- Blog: 8 files across en/ko/vi still said VI/KO 'planned' - aligned
  with the already-updated RU/EN counterparts; lastmod bumped to
  2026-09-10 in each edited article.

Slice 2 - surface 'grammar & kanji N5-N1' (4 locales):
- Home hero subtitle and home meta description (unified 'N5-N1' with
  U+2013), features meta description EN/RU aligned with KO/VI.
- Compare page: bunpro/wanikani 'Origa advantage' copy mentions N5-N1
  (framed as unification, not competitor disparagement).
- README Kanji/Grammar bullets and llms.txt kanji line now say N5-N1.

Tests:
- ko_vi_landing_have_no_wip_banner: /ko and /vi render without the
  banner markup or its Korean/Vietnamese wording.
- home_schema_description_covers_jlpt_levels_all_locales: home
  description must state N5-N1 in every locale (guards against the
  locale drift that caused this bug).

Note: vi_articles_do_not_contain_kanji fails on master already (a
/vi/docs/kanji link predates this PR); landing integration tests are
not run by CI (ci.yml runs cargo test --workspace --exclude
origa_landing).

entry.title: review: address the code review findings on the SIWA re-sign pipeline
entry.content:
review: address the code review findings on the SIWA re-sign pipeline

- manage_ios_profiles.py: actually handle the 204 No Content body on
  DELETE (the previous 'fix' was a no-op expression).
- mint_ios_identity.py: purge stale identities by id through the
  profile relationship instead of a certificate-CN match (Apple rewrites
  CNs to the account holder name, so the CN branch could never fire and
  would have been dangerous if it had); write cert-id/profile-id to
  GITHUB_OUTPUT immediately after each creation so a crash cannot orphan
  a certificate; tolerate 404 in cleanup (parallel-run races); validate
  response shapes via expect_data; surface openssl stderr; context
  managers + encoding for file IO.
- workflow: guard the entitlement Add (idempotent if tauri-cli ever
  starts embedding it), document the Payload-only repack contract, and
  extend the always() cleanup to delete the resign keychain and the key
  material (mirrors the macOS job convention).
- Swift: single ASAuthorizationError unwrap with a .unknown case instead
  of the magic 1000.

entry.title: fix(apple): mint an Apple-issued identity + profile for the SIWA re-sign
entry.content:
fix(apple): mint an Apple-issued identity + profile for the SIWA re-sign

App Store Connect rejects uploads whose signing certificate is not
contained in the embedded provisioning profile (-19241), so the
self-signed identity cannot pass validation. Mirror tauri-cli exactly:
mint an Apple-issued Apple Distribution certificate via the ASC API,
create a fresh IOS_APP_STORE profile containing it, replace the embedded
profile, merge applesignin into the current entitlements and re-sign.
An always() step deletes the cert/profile afterwards; stale CI-minted
certificates (including tauri-cli's throwaway Tauri (unset) ones, whose
keys die with the runners) are purged before minting.

entry.title: fix(apple): full keychain path for the codesign lookup
entry.content:
fix(apple): full keychain path for the codesign lookup

codesign --keychain expects a keychain path, not a bare name, and the
keychain must be in the user search list for the imported key and cert
to link into one identity.

entry.title: fix(apple): codeSigning EKU on the self-signed re-sign identity
entry.content:
fix(apple): codeSigning EKU on the self-signed re-sign identity

security find-identity -p codesigning (and codesign's own lookup) only
accept certs with the codeSigning extended key usage — a bare openssl
-x509 cert has none.
